name: HBDesigner
description: Datasets and scripts for reproducing the key computational results in the HBDesigner paper: https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.06.08.730848. From the README: Additional datasets and scripts for reproducing HBDesigner benchmarks as described in the HBDesigner paper. General scaffold sets: scaffold_sets/denovo_monomer_scaffolds: 726 monomeric de novo scaffolds of length 80-120, generated by RFdiffusion and filtered for globularity. Used for Table 1, Figure 2G, and Extended Data Figure 1A.
